title: AquaRehearsal-X Field Check: Citizen Observation and Prediction Verification System

disclaimers.general_disclaimer: AquaRehearsal-X Field Check is a citizen-science observation and model-verification platform, NOT a substitute for laboratory environmental testing or certified municipal water quality enforcement.
disclaimers.health_disclaimer: Human recreational contact risk has NOT been laboratory-assessed unless official certified bacteriological measurements (e.g. E. coli / enterococci) or municipal health department advisories are explicitly cited. Do NOT infer pathogen levels from water appearance, foam, or odor alone. Never enter floodwaters.
disclaimers.unverified_notice: Unverified field submissions represent subjective citizen observations and have not yet undergone professional QA/QC verification.
